title: Level1Engines
description: The registry of cloud level-1 engines in the per-user state directory, <state>/level1-engines.yaml (ADR-0030, ADR-0035, ADR-0044). There is none by default. The built-in local engine needs no entry. Each entry names an engine id, the wire preset of the System One adapter and the https base URL; the credential is never stored here, only the path of an owner-only file that holds it. Nothing is sent to an engine without a hash-bound confirmation of that transfer (ADR-0031). Local state: never sent, exported or shared.

id.description: The engine id, as in a prediction and as the proposal author agent:<id>. `local`, `local-rules` and the name of a registered agent connection are not allowed.

preset.description: The wire format of the adapter. `jev` is the Jev preset, whose wire format is unconfirmed (owner decision OD-4); `generic` is the generic POST /v1/decide template.

baseUrl.description: https base URL of the service (http only on a loopback address), without credentials.

enabled.description: A listed engine that is not enabled is shown as unavailable and never called.

apiKeyFile.description: Path of an owner-only file (mode 0600 on POSIX) that holds the bearer credential; relative paths are resolved against the state directory. Omit for a service without a credential.
